title: Area–Angular-Momentum Inequalities with Nonpositive Cosmological Constant
exact_target: Find sharp horizon area bounds with zero or negative cosmological constant and classify equality in the related charge bound.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003918 (OWR-16411-011). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical General Relativity (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/36, pp. 2157--2251. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 78.
Gabach Clement--Jaramillo review (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The source $A\geq8\pi|J_S|$ is the reference inequality. The question asks for the appropriate $\Lambda\leq0$ extension and extremal AdS role, rather than presupposing that its unchanged right-hand side is sharp in every case. The charge rigidity task is also retained.
